headline: Advisory review of subdivisions on Point Ave, Walmsley Lane, LaPorte property, and a 275-unit Lofts on Fairgrounds development.
summary: The committee will give advisory reviews on administrative subdivisions at Point Avenue and Walmsley Lane, a minor subdivision for David LaPorte, and a preliminary plan for a 275-unit Lofts on Fairgrounds development at 132 Fairgrounds Road.
items: Point Avenue Administrative Subdivision – advisory review to recombine and reconfigure property boundaries at 62A, 62B, & 76 Point Ave (AP 82-4, Lots 28, 29, 30); Laurie Keene of Keene Architecture Inc., applicant; Daniel and Susan Cromie and the Susan E. Cromie Revocable Trust, owners

Walmsley Lane Administrative Subdivision – advisory review to reconfigure property boundaries at 35 Walmsley Lane and 40 Lacey Lane (AP 27-1, Lot 12 and AP 19-4, Lot 4); Eric Prive of DiPrete Engineering, applicant; Gerald and Loretta Petros, and Barry Bellino, owners
LaPorte Minor Subdivision – advisory review of a Minor Subdivision for Administrative Officer approval; AP 68-2, Lot 18; David LaPorte, applicant/owner

Major Land Development, Preliminary Plan Review (Comprehensive Permit) – Lofts on Fairgrounds: proposed six-building multi-family development with an amenity building, totaling 275 residential units, at 132 Fairgrounds Road (Assessor's Plat 21-3, Lot 9); 132 Fairgrounds, LLC, applicant/owner
location: Town Council Chambers, South Kingstown Town Hall, 180 High Street, Wakefield, RI 02879
plain_text:
Posted on October 14, 2026 
 
Town of South Kingstown  
Technical Review Committee (TRC)  
Meeting Agenda   
Wednesday, October 21, 2026 at 9:00 AM   
South Kingstown Town Hall, Town Council Chambers 
180 High Street, Wakefield, RI 02879 
www.southkingstownri.gov  
 
  
A. Call to Order & Roll Call 
B. Approval of Minutes: 
 1. September 9, 2026 
C. TRC Review: 
D. TRC Advisory Review: 
 1. Point Avenue Administrative Subdivision – Advisory review of an Administrative Subdivision to recombine 
and reconfigure the property boundaries on the subject site located at 62A, 62B, & 76 Point Ave (AP 82-4, 
Lots 28, 29, 30), Laurie Keene of Keene Architecture Inc., applicant; Daniel and Susan Cromie and the Susan 
E. Cromie Revocable Trust, owners.  
 2. Walmsley Lane Administrative Subdivision – Advisory review of an Administrative Subdivision to 
reconfigure the property boundaries on the subject site located at 35 Walmsley Lane and 40 Lacey Lane (AP 
27-1, Lot 12 and AP 19-4, Lot 4), Eric Prive of DiPrete Engineering, applicant; Gerald and Loretta Petros, and 
Barry Bellino, owners.  
 3. LaPorte Minor Subdivision - Advisory review of a Minor Subdivision for Administrative Officer approval.  AP 
68-2, Lot 18.  David LaPorte, applicant/owner. 
 4. Major Land Development, Preliminary Plan Review (Comprehensive Permit) — Lofts on Fairgrounds 
Proposed six (6) building multi-family development with an amenity building at the entrance. Each building 
provides a mixture of studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom units for a total of 275 residential units and 
associated site improvements. Located at 132 Fairgrounds Road on Assessor's Plat 21-3, Lot 9. 132 
Fairgrounds, LLC, applicant/owner. 
  
E. Adjournment:
